description: Shows a date and time relative to now, such as 3 minutes ago or in 2 days, in the user's language, with the exact date on hover, and keeps it current.

inputs.name: Timestamp
inputs.description: The moment to show, in ISO 8601 (for example 2026-10-22T10:00:00Z). From an OutSystems DateTime, use FormatDateTime(<value>, "yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss"), which is read in the browser's time zone; add "Z" when the value is UTC.

inputs.name: Locale
inputs.description: A BCP 47 language tag such as pt-PT or en-GB, for the words and the date format. Empty uses the browser's language.

inputs.name: EmptyLabel
inputs.description: Shown when Timestamp is empty or not a valid date.

inputs.name: Live
inputs.description: Refresh the text every 30 seconds, so 'just now' becomes '1 minute ago' without a screen refresh.

modifiers.description: Secondary text colour and a smaller size, for metadata lines.
